# Broadnet Internet Services

> Broadnet (Est. 2014) is Avadi and Chennai's authorized security systems integrator and internet service provider, specializing in Hikvision and CP PLUS CCTV installations, ColorVu night vision, AcuSense AI surveillance, eSSL biometric access control, video door phones, and high-speed fiber broadband.

Broadnet provides end-to-end security surveillance and ICT infrastructure across Avadi, Thirumullaivoyal, Ambattur, Pattabiram, Poonamallee, and Chennai with guaranteed 2-hour technician dispatch.

## Core Pages & Services

- [Broadnet Official Website](https://www.broadnet.in/): Homepage with verified reviews, brand certifications, and instant quotation builder.
- [CCTV Security Cameras](https://www.broadnet.in/security/cameras/): Hikvision & CP PLUS CCTV camera packages, ColorVu 24/7 full-color night vision, and AcuSense AI human/vehicle detection.
- [CCTV Quick Quote Landing](https://www.broadnet.in/cctv-landing/): Turnkey CCTV packages (1 to 128+ channels), camera kits, and fast on-site survey booking.
- [CCTV AMC Maintenance](https://www.broadnet.in/services/cctv-amc/): Annual maintenance contracts (AMC) for apartments, residential societies, schools, and industrial factories.
- [Biometric Attendance & Access Control](https://www.broadnet.in/services/biometric-attendance/): Authorized eSSL facial recognition scanners, biometric fingerprint machines, and electromagnetic door locks.
- [Video Door Phones](https://www.broadnet.in/security/door-phones/): High-definition color touchscreens with weatherproof outdoor bell cameras and smartphone remote unlock.
- [Fiber Broadband Internet](https://www.broadnet.in/internet/): High-speed symmetrical fiber optic broadband from 60 Mbps (₹499/mo) to 300 Mbps with RailWire and BSNL Bharat Fibre.
- [Enterprise Wi-Fi & Networking](https://www.broadnet.in/services/enterprise-wifi/): Grandstream Wi-Fi 6 access points, structured Cat6 cabling, firewall routers, and server racks.
- [Service Areas & Dispatch SLAs](https://www.broadnet.in/service-areas/): Full coverage map with 2-hour technician dispatch in Avadi, Thirumullaivoyal, Ambattur, Pattabiram, and Chennai.
- [About Broadnet](https://www.broadnet.in/about/): 12+ years history, 2,500+ completed installations, HCSA certification, and enterprise leadership.
- [Contact & Quote Request](https://www.broadnet.in/contact/): Request an on-site security inspection, WhatsApp quote (+91 86818 88111), or direct phone support.
